name: Takoda Spur
address: Seefront Shopping Mall, Paardekraal Ave, Hartenbos, Mossel Bay, 6520, South Africa
description_short: Family-friendly American-style steakhouse in Hartenbos serving burgers, ribs, and breakfast favourites with a cheerful vibe.
description_long:
Takoda Spur brings the familiar charm of the Spur family to Hartenbos, tucked inside Seefront Shopping Mall on Paardekraal Avenue. It's the kind of place where kids are genuinely welcome, with colouring pages and balloon animals keeping the little ones entertained while parents tuck into flame-grilled steaks, sticky ribs, and towering burgers. The breakfast menu runs throughout the day, so whether you're craving a full English or just good coffee and pancakes, you're sorted.

The atmosphere is casual and relaxed, perfect for families after a beach day or groups looking for something easy and satisfying. While it won't win awards for fine dining, it delivers exactly what you'd expect from a Spur: consistent portions, friendly service, and that unmistakable peri-peri sauce on the side. The location in the shopping centre makes it convenient for a quick meal while running errands or refuelling before heading back to the coast. It's unpretentious, reliable, and knows its audience well.
